notes.title: Reach BlockDude all over the web!
notes.content:
Follow BlockDude on social networks:
  - Facebook
  - Twitter & Mastodon

Any feedback is more than welcome, don't hesitate to express your feelings to the following address: the.hazardous.dude+support@gmail.com

BlockDude is also available for Android on the Google Play Store!
